Name: Orangeblossom's Not-So-Basic Kitchen and Add-ons
Author: orangeblossom7
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=3]Not-S0-Basic Kitchen Replacement & Add-ons[/size]
[i]by orangeblossom[/i]
[/font][/center][font=Georgia]
Hello, everyone. ◝(ᵔᵕᵔ)◜ 

I'm back with another kitchen replacement mod! The colors for the counters and appliances are pretty limited [i]for now[/i] because recolor inspirations (that are not pastel-themed) have not yet struck me!

My mind's still on the macaron recolor I was previously working on, plus I've also started playing the game again so mod updates will be pretty slow. (๑-﹏-๑) [/font][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc]
[/color]

[center][i][color=#f4f4f4][size=5]♡[/size][/color][size=5]  [/size][size=6]follow me on [url=https://orangeblossoms7.tumblr.com/]tumblr[/url]﻿ or [url=https://bsky.app/profile/orangeblossom7.bsky.social]bluesky[/url]﻿! [/size][/i][i][size=5]♡[/size][/i][/center]
[center]- - - -[/center]
[u]Available colors:[/u]
[list]
[*]Counter: [i]white, green, blue, black, grey[/i]
[*]Countertops: [i]basic, birch, black, brown, chocolate brown, grey[/i]
[*]Appliances: [i]silver, silver2, black[/i]
[/list]
[u]Furniture list:[/u]
[list]
[*]kitchen island (w/ and w/o sink in the middle)
[*]stool
[/list]
[u]Important notes:[/u]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia]The kitchen island and stools can be found in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23073]furniture catalogue[/url].[/font]
[*][font=Georgia]You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]alternative textures[/url] to change the swatches of the kitchen island and stool (I also recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]happy home designer[/url]﻿ because it integrates AT functionality even with custom catalogues like mine. If you have happy home designer installed, you won't need to interact with the object using the paint bucket; you can directly access the different swatches by interacting with my furniture catalogue instead).[/font]
[*][font=Georgia]You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]generic mod config menu﻿[/url] (GMCM) to easily change the colors of the counters, countertops, and appliances. If you don't have GMCM, you can, of course, just mess with config.json.[/font]
[*][font=Georgia]Make sure '﻿[i]KitchenAppliance[/i]' and '﻿[i]KitchenApplianceOpenFridge[/i]' are set to the same swatch (e.g. both must be set to Black).[/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[u]Issues:[/u]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia]The kitchen might look cut-off in weird places if you use a farmhouse mod that alters the order of the kitchen tilesheets, [i]or[/i] does not use the whole 4 or 5 tiles (that are grouped together) for the kitchen. For example, if the farmhouse mod you're using only uses 2 of the vanilla kitchen tiles, this mod will only show you the fridge.[/font]
[/list]
